title: BUGFIX — Purge synthetic test users from daily-counts.json + add E2E cleanup
rationale: workspace/achiri/daily-counts.json had 82 synthetic test user IDs (e2e-test-*, e2e-safety-*, validate-sprint-*, tarek-test, smoke-test, etc.) vs 1 real user (6001921477). These inflated user counts in all 7 analytics scripts (achiri-retention, achiri-quality-monitor, achiri-readiness, achiri-dashboard-export, achiri-topic-analytics, export-analytics, weekly-usage-digest). Sprint 1416/1417 filtered at send-time but didn't fix the data. This sprint does a one-time purge and adds cleanup to validate-e2e-alpha.ts to prevent future recurrence.

tasks.description: One-time: purge all non-numeric user keys from workspace/achiri/daily-counts.json. Used python3 to filter in-place. Removed 84 entries (84 synthetic, 0 real users affected). File now only contains userId '6001921477' on 2026-03-19 and 2026-03-20.

Add cleanupTestUsersFromDailyCounts() to validate-e2e-alpha.ts. Runs after all tests complete — removes any non-numeric userId keys written to daily-counts.json during the test run. In practice dry-run mode skips incrementDailyCount() so no test users are written; function is a safeguard for future non-dry-run test scenarios.
